items.reason: Collapsed the forked sweep-honesty layer that grants-gov and ca-grants each carried privately (SweepEnd, walk_end, empty_page_is_drift, sweep_warning, append_warning) into grants-common, with the only genuinely per-source part — the nouns — travelling as a new SweepVocab struct so every emitted warning is byte-identical; cordis's hand-rolled warnings insert now goes through the same door.

Flipping `verified: false` in .ai/manifest.yaml means actually running each capability (cargo test, just ci, pwsh smoke); this session has no shell, and editing the flags without running the commands would make the manifest lie in the opposite direction.

Mutation testing requires installing and running cargo-mutants over crates/core — no network to fetch it and no shell to run it; a committed cargo-mutants config with no evidence of a run is exactly the detector-without-the-work this lane forbids.

A commits-per-PR / time-to-merge budget has to be calibrated against this repo's actual history before a ceiling is honest, and git is unavailable in this session; an uncalibrated threshold would be a number invented rather than measured.

Drafted the skill input/output/failure-mode contract for .claude/skills/passport-onboard/SKILL.md plus a sibling README defining the shape, but the write to .claude/skills/ was refused by this session's permissions, so nothing landed.

lessons: This repo records its own deferred refactors inside the doc comment of the code that carries the debt ("lifting all three copies into grants_common is the follow-up"). Grepping doc comments for phrases like "the follow-up" / "deliberately left in place" / "out of this change's write set" surfaces pre-approved, pre-designed de-duplication work faster than any duplicate-function scan.

When unifying forked helpers here, the fork is usually justified by per-source WORDING rather than per-source logic. Lifting the wording into a small Copy struct of &'static str and asserting each dialect's exact rendering in the shared crate lets the deletion be byte-for-byte output-preserving, so no downstream test assertion has to be relaxed — which matters because this repo treats a changed assertion as a lowered bar.

Sessions in this lane may have no shell at all: cargo, git and sed were all refused here. Plan rungs that are verifiable by reading (deletions, signature-preserving unifications) and skip rungs whose whole content is running a tool.
